rootCauseAt50c: All 73 failures were HTTP 500 = OpenEmrFhirError (OpenEMR FHIR API returned 500), NOT LLM rate limits. The agent assembles context by fanning out 5 FHIR reads per /chat in Promise.all; 50 concurrent chats => ~250 concurrent FHIR calls saturating OpenEMR PHP/MariaDB (peaked >1 core). Two amplifiers: (1) no Patient Snapshot cache yet (ARCHITECTURE.md 3) so every turn re-reads all 5 resources; (2) Promise.all has no per-tool isolation, so one FHIR 500 rejects the whole request instead of degrading.
